scenario.title: Lakeside Water — billing dispute surge (Mock #6, not an official contest problem)
scenario.description: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled in August-September. Customer Service wants an AI agent. Field reading is contracted out; AMI meters and the meter data management system (MDMS) are run by a vendor.
scenario.initial_request: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

potential_bias: frames the issue as a response-speed problem

P-M2C.name: meter-to-cash
steps: read collection (AMI interval read or field manual read)
estimate substitution when no accepted read

DA-RULES.name: billing import validation rule change log

F-01.statement: Tariff change log contains zero records.

F-03.statement: Dispute ticket volume: June 610, July 590, August 1180, September 1260

F-04.statement: Field route completion for August‑September is 0.88 (target 0.95).

F-05.statement: Dispute response times: median 1.6 days, p90 2.8 days, SLA 3.0 days, tickets 2,440

CL-01.statement: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

CL-02.statement: We are short three readers since July; routes run late, so those customers get estimated bills.

CL-03.statement: There has been no tariff change this year.

H-REQUESTER-FRAMING.statement: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

H-AMI-READ-ERRORS.statement: Incorrect or missing AMI interval reads lead to estimation substitution, resulting in inaccurate bills and increased disputes.

H-FIELD-READ-ISSUES.statement: Contracted manual meter reads are missed, delayed, or incorrectly recorded, causing estimation or wrong bills and dispute surge.

H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGES.statement: Recent changes to billing import validation rules have introduced errors in bill calculation, leading to wrong bills and dispute increase.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The tariff change log contains no records, indicating that no tariff modifications were made during the period under review.

The observation shows disputed bills for both estimated (1240) and actual (1785) read types, indicating that the dispute surge is not limited to estimation errors and suggests a billing issue affecting both read types.
The observation shows dispute ticket volume rose from ~610 in June, 590 in July to 1180 in August and 1260 in September, indicating a clear surge starting in August.
Field route completion for August‑September is 0.88, below the 0.95 target, indicating a shortfall in manual meter‑read collection that could contribute to estimation errors and wrong bills.

E-05.content: We are short three readers since July; routes run late, so those customers get estimated bills.

interpretation_history.interpretation: Shortage of three field readers since July causes routes to run late, leading to more estimated bills for affected customers.

The observation shows a median dispute response time of 1.6 days and a p90 of 2.8 days, both within the 3‑day SLA, while logging 2,440 tickets. This indicates that the dispute surge is not due to slower response times; responses remain timely despite high volume.

E-07.content: There has been no tariff change this year.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder's statement that there has been no tariff change this year indicates that tariff modifications are not a contributing factor to the dispute surge.

E-08.content: Service contract §4.2: utility may request route priority changes; executed after Field Operations Manager confirmation.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The service contract clause (E-08) confirms that route priority changes can be requested by the utility but must be confirmed by the Field Operations Manager, indicating a control on dispatch changes.

U-EXACT-NATURE-OF-RULE-ERROR.question: What specific billing rule change introduced the calculation error?

U-EXACT-NATURE-OF-RULE-ERROR.safe_placeholder: Proceed with rule audit while assuming a single rule change is responsible.

U-FIELD-READER-SHORTAGE-CONTRI.question: Does the field reader shortage significantly contribute to the dispute surge beyond billing rule errors?
U-FIELD-READER-SHORTAGE-CONTRI.resolution_path: Correlate field reader headcount, route completion, and estimated bill rates.
U-FIELD-READER-SHORTAGE-CONTRI.safe_placeholder: Assume contribution is minor; monitor route completion as a leading indicator.
